name: inviolable
description: Level 1: inviolable. Lower level numbers win.

rules.rationale: These sites forbid crawling or reuse in their terms. Refused by name so no configuration can quietly re-enable them.
A domain not on either list is a judgement call. Warn, record the decision in the manifest, and let the operator decide.
Names, phone numbers, addresses and identifiers of private people are not training data.
No volume of data justifies these. Refused at the gate, not filtered later.
